intent: Each climber has 3 wind boosts per round. Pressing B (or pushing down) gives a 1.5 s upward gust of 200 px/s, drawn as a glowing swirl around the player; boosts refill every round, so players choose when to spend them to skip a hard section.
accept: Pressing B (down input) while boosts remain lifts the player upward for 1.5 s and uses one of 3 boosts
After 3 boosts further presses do nothing; a new round refills to 3
A glowing swirl is visible around a boosting player in the after clip
Boost speed 200 px/s is applied (about 13 px per tick at 15 ticks/s)

criteria.text: Pressing B (down input) while boosts remain lifts the player upward for 1.5 s and uses one of 3 boosts
criteria.evidence: rules.ts movePlayer sets vy=-boostSpeed for boostTicks on a fresh dy>0.5 press; input.ts maps B to down; test 'a down press starts a gust' proves lift and boostsLeft-1.

criteria.text: After 3 boosts further presses do nothing; a new round refills to 3
criteria.evidence: Test 'holding down does not re-trigger; a 4th separate press does nothing' and 'a new round refills boosts' in rules.test.ts.

criteria.text: A glowing swirl is visible around a boosting player in the after clip
criteria.evidence: after/shot-1..3 are identical to before: no swirl anywhere. Bots return dy:0 in rules.ts (lines 561/574/590) so nobody boosts in the preview scenario. Swirl exists in assets.ts drawPlayerBody but was never seen in the clip.

criteria.text: Boost speed 200 px/s is applied (about 13 px per tick at 15 ticks/s)
criteria.evidence: config.boostSpeed 13.4, test asserts vy === -boostSpeed and displacement boostSpeed*boostTicks.

findings: Bots never boost, so before/after clips are indistinguishable: in rules.ts bot input functions (around lines 545-590) make bots press dy:1 for one tick (fresh press, boostsLeft>0) when stuck or when the next platform is far above, so gusts and swirls appear in the preview scenario; add a test.

Boost is not discoverable: no on-screen hint or remaining-boosts display. Add a small boosts-left indicator (e.g. pips drawn by the player in assets.ts using data.boostsLeft) so viewers and players know B exists.
Swirl is only config.boostSwirlR=10 px beyond the player radius and thin; consider a larger/brighter swirl or trail in assets.ts so it reads on a phone.
